_comment: Machine-readable state of the six progression tracks (templates/progression-tracks.md). tools/update_tracks.py rewrites it from data/history.csv; tools/hevy_push_routines.py reads it to fill routine loads. data/track-state.md is the narrative companion; its table is regenerated from this file with `update_tracks.py --write-md`. Units: lb (the Hevy app is set to lb; the API and data/history.csv carry kg, and the tools convert). top_set_lb is the planned load for the NEXT heavy exposure (section 5 rule already applied); last_h_load_lb is what was actually lifted at the last heavy exposure (the gap table in section 8 holds or reduces from that). A null top_set_lb with work_up=true means: work up on the first heavy exposure and log the load found. Bench and press have no fractional plates: increment_every = 2 means +5 lb after every second successful top set; step_counter counts the successes so far.

no RPE logged; e1RM at assumed RPE 8. Amended by hand: race-week title not parsed by the engine

deadlift.work_up_note: Warm up, then 95 x 4, 115 x 4, 135 x 4, 145 x 4, +10 lb per set until 4 reps feel like RPE 8. Stop there; that load is the track load.

e1rm_history.note: pulldown; switch to the bar when a pulldown set at about bodyweight reaches 8

accessories._comment: Keyed by the exercise 'name' in templates/rotation.json. weight_lb for a two-dumbbell exercise is the total of both dumbbells, as the lifter logs it in Hevy (two 20-lb dumbbells = 40); for a one-dumbbell exercise it is that dumbbell; null means choose on the day and record it here afterwards. step is the load step written into the routine note.

Incline DB press.note: total of both dumbbells (35 each); 70 x 6, 8, 8 on 10 Nov 2026 (range 8-12: hold until every set reaches 12)

Lateral raise.note: total of both dumbbells (10 each); 20 x 15, 20, 20, 20 on 10 Nov 2026 (one set short of the top: next time every set at 20, then 25 total)

Cable lateral raise.note: or DB lateral raise at the DB lateral raise load (total of both dumbbells)

Incline DB curl.note: total of both dumbbells (15 each); standing DB curl 35 total x 12, 10, 8 on 4 Nov 2026 (incline runs lighter)

Overhead triceps extension.step: +5 lb (one pin), or +2.5 lb on a dumbbell
Overhead triceps extension.note: one dumbbell held in both hands; cable stack if available. 27.5 x 8 x 3 on 10 Nov 2026, 8s at 25 and 27.5 since 20 Oct, under the 10-15 range: use 25 and log the real reps

Reverse lunge or split squat.note: total of both dumbbells (17.5 each); 30 total x 12 per leg x 3 on 29 Oct 2026

Flat DB press or dips.step: +5 lb total (2.5 lb per dumbbell), or bodyweight dips
Flat DB press or dips.note: dumbbell load is the total of both

Hack squat.step: +10 lb (one 5-lb plate a side) or one pin
Hack squat.note: squat substitute (station taken); choose on the day and record it

Leg press.step: +10 lb (one 5-lb plate a side) or one pin

Bulgarian split squat.note: squat substitute, needs only dumbbells and a bench; total of both dumbbells, per leg; starts at the reverse-lunge load

DB bench press.note: bench substitute; total of both dumbbells. Start near 80 total (about 70-80% of the barbell bench, practitioner rule) and adjust by RPE

Machine chest press.note: bench substitute; choose on the day and record it

Trap-bar deadlift.note: deadlift substitute; choose on the day and record it

Smith machine squat.note: squat substitute, first choice (closest transfer to the barbell squat: Saeterbakken 2019); choose on the day and record it
